name: Autonomous Research
description: Research harness for the hub's research view: a director agent runs idea → venue → literature → plan → experiments → analysis → paper → review, with hooks, a watchdog and phase gates.
usage:
1. Install, choosing where research projects go.
2. Restart the hub once: the research view then uses this harness.
3. New → Research director in the hub; follow progress in the Research section.
4. Edit local-env.md in the harness folder to describe your machine (GPU, disks, rules).
purpose: Lets a long research task keep going turn after turn without the user, while limits and gates stay outside the agent's reach.

store.tagline: A director agent that takes a research direction to a reviewed paper draft

settings.label: Research projects folder
settings.description: Each project is created here as its own git repository. Never inside the harness folder.

settings.label: Harness folder
settings.description: Where the harness (templates, hooks, tools, limits) is installed. Default: inside the app folder.

settings.label: Claude Code skills folder
settings.description: Optional. Folder with paper-review / paper-claims / paper-numbers / paper-code skills (default ~/.claude/skills).

settings.label: Machine rules file
settings.description: Optional Markdown with this machine's rules (GPU queue, disks, network). Copied into each new project's CLAUDE.md.

settings.label: Usage soft limit (%)
settings.description: Above this share of the plan's usage the director slows down.

settings.label: Usage hard limit (%)
settings.description: Above this the director waits for the reset.
